moments.title: Cardiff City in Carabao Cup action
moments.blurb: Cardiff City kick off their Carabao Cup campaign today at home against Swindon Town in the First Round.

angles.name: Match Day Hype
angles.copy: It's Carabao Cup First Round day! Cardiff City face Swindon Town at home this afternoon. What are your predictions, Bluebirds?

moments.title: Swansea City Carabao Cup opener
moments.blurb: Swansea City begin their 2026/27 season with a Carabao Cup First Round tie at home against Birmingham City today.

angles.name: Kick-off excitement
angles.copy: The Swans are BACK! First game of the season, Carabao Cup clash against Birmingham City this afternoon. How are we feeling, Jack Army?

moments.title: Happy 65th to The Edge
moments.blurb: U2 guitarist The Edge, born David Evans, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge! What's your favourite U2 riff?

moments.title: Shawn Mendes turns 28
moments.blurb: Canadian pop superstar Shawn Mendes is celebrating his 28th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Prince Bday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 28th Birthday to the one and only Shawn Mendes! What's your go-to Shawn track?

moments.title: NSYNC's JC Chasez is 50!
moments.blurb: Former NSYNC lead vocalist JC Chasez celebrates his 50th birthday today.

angles.name: Boyband Icon
angles.copy: Happy 50th Birthday to NSYNC's very own JC Chasez! What's your favourite NSYNC anthem?

moments.title: Creed's Scott Stapp turns 53
moments.blurb: Scott Stapp, the distinctive voice of post-grunge band Creed, is celebrating his 53rd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Voice Bday
angles.copy: Happy 53rd Birthday to Scott Stapp of Creed! What's your favourite Creed track to belt out?

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK debut in London
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic hip hop festival, originally from Philadelphia, makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9, 2026.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: History in the making! The legendary Roots Picnic festival is live at Crystal Palace Bowl today and tomorrow. Who's there?

moments.title: Devon Derby in League Cup
moments.blurb: Exeter City face local rivals Plymouth Argyle in the League Cup at Home Park on Monday, August 10.

angles.name: Derby Day Anticipation
angles.copy: The big one is coming! Exeter City take on Plymouth Argyle in the League Cup on Monday. Who's ready for the Devon Derby?

moments.title: Medicine Festival kicks off
moments.blurb: The Medicine Festival, celebrating indigenous wisdom, live music, and wellness, runs from August 12-17, 2026.

angles.name: Wellness & Music
angles.copy: Looking for some good vibes? Medicine Festival starts on Wednesday, offering a unique blend of music, wellness, and culture. Who's heading there?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK No. 1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean extend their record-breaking run with 'Rein Me In' for a 20th week at No. 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: 20 WEEKS at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' continues its incredible run. Is it the song of the summer?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal against FA Cup winners Manchester City.

angles.name: Season Curtain-Raiser
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The Community Shield clash between Arsenal and Man City is heading to Cardiff's Principality Stadium next Sunday. Who's taking home the first silverware?

moments.title: Swansea City Championship opener
moments.blurb: Swansea City start their Championship season away to Stoke City on Saturday, August 15.

angles.name: League Action Begins
angles.copy: Beyond the Cup, the Championship season starts next Saturday for Swansea City! They're away at Stoke. Ready for the league campaign?

moments.title: Cardiff vs Wrexham Welsh Derby
moments.blurb: Cardiff City's Championship season kicks off with a massive Welsh derby at home against newly promoted Wrexham on Monday, August 17.

angles.name: Big Welsh Opener
angles.copy: What a way to start the Championship season! Cardiff City host Wrexham in a huge Welsh derby next Monday. Who's getting tickets?

moments.title: Exeter City League Two opener
moments.blurb: Exeter City begin their League Two campaign with an away trip to Grimsby Town on Saturday, August 15.

angles.name: Grecians Kick-off
angles.copy: The Grecians are back in League Two action next Saturday! Exeter City travel to Grimsby Town for their season opener. Up the City!

moments.title: Joe Jonas turns 37
moments.blurb: Jonas Brothers and DNCE frontman Joe Jonas celebrates his 37th birthday on August 15.

angles.name: Pop Star Bday
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate! Joe Jonas of Jonas Brothers and DNCE turns 37 next Saturday. What's your favourite tune from him?

moments.title: Doobie Brothers' Tom Johnston is 78
moments.blurb: Tom Johnston, lead singer and guitarist for The Doobie Brothers, will be 78 on August 15.

angles.name: Rock Legend Bday
angles.copy: Next Saturday, we're celebrating the legendary Tom Johnston of The Doobie Brothers, who turns 78! What's your favourite Doobie Brothers classic?

moments.title: Boyzone's Mikey Graham turns 54
moments.blurb: Boyzone member Mikey Graham will celebrate his 54th birthday on August 15.

angles.name: Boyband Heartthrob
angles.copy: Next Saturday, it's a happy 54th birthday to Boyzone's Mikey Graham! What's your favourite Boyzone track?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival approaches
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating soul, hip hop, house, jazz and more, takes place in Dorset from August 20-23, 2026.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on for We Out Here Festival! Gilles Peterson's incredible celebration of music and culture kicks off in Dorset on August 20th. Who's heading down?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival just weeks away
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals, featuring a huge lineup including Charli XCX, Chase & Status Live, and Skepta, return from August 27-30, 2026.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Not long now! Reading & Leeds Festival is just weeks away, with a massive lineup taking over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park. Who are you most excited to see?
